title: Real-World Care Registry of the Hypertension Center at the University Hospital Cologne
summary: This registry includes patients receiving care in the specialized hypertension clinic at the University Hospital Cologne. The aim is to better understand the real-world management of high blood pressure and to identify factors associated with good or poor blood pressure control. Routinely collected medical data from outpatient care are analyzed and supplemented during future visits.

interventions.name: Retrospective und prospektive analysis of all patients receiving care for arterial hypertension in the specialized hypertension clinic of the University Hospital Cologne.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with arterial hypertension treated between 2011 and 2031 in the specialized hypertension clinic of the University Hospital Cologne.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients without arterial hypertension
Lack of informed consent for prospective data collection
